context: The two kids visit Sachiko to show her something they made for baby Hikari.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: お祖母様、ひかりちゃんに、作ったよ！
lines.en: Grandma, we made something for Hikari-chan!
lines.style: Bright, proud presentation. Quick opening, then slows down on the gift reveal. Audible smile. Barely contained excitement held in soft, genuine warmth.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: え、見せて。何を、作ったの？
lines.en: Oh, show me. What did you make?
lines.style: Warm, engaged grandmotherly curiosity. Opens soft and inviting. Leans in slightly. Genuine interest — not performing, just delighted to see what they've done.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 靴下と、絵。一緒に、作った。
lines.en: Socks and a picture. We made it together.
lines.style: Quiet, steady pride without fanfare. Small voice, but clear. Soft emphasis on 'together' — noticing the collaboration. Genuine warmth, no performance.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 本当に、優しい二人だね。ひかりちゃん、絶対、喜ぶ。
lines.en: You two are truly so kind. Hikari-chan will definitely be so happy.
lines.style: Soft, genuine praise delivered as quiet observation. Warm tone throughout. Slight pause before the second sentence, as if she's feeling the weight of their kindness. Tender, unhurried.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: ひな、ちゃんと、お姉さんに、なる！
lines.en: I'm going to be a proper big sister!
lines.style: Bright determination with child-sized conviction. Opens energetic, then settles into sincere commitment. The softness underneath the bravery audible. Whole-hearted, no doubt.
